title: Local Government Directory (LGD): village entities of Rajasthan, Bikaner district extract (3,063 villages) with census 2001/2011 codes, GP mapping and last transaction
villages_named: all acquired villages: absent as separate entities; only "Mahajan Fieldfiring Range" (LGD 69202) exists
what_it_contains: Public POST web service (no login, no captcha). 52,591 active Rajasthan villages; Bikaner 11 sub-districts. LGD 69202 "Mahajan Fieldfiring Range", Lunkaransar sub-district 475, census2001 00509900, census2011 069202, majorVersion 3 (last change 2019-01-08), villageStatus "I". The web service returns only ACTIVE villages; none of the 32 pre-1991 villages exists as a deleted/merged LGD entity (LGD was built from Census 2001/2011, after they had already vanished).
why_relevant: Confirms the official present-day administrative status: the whole range is one revenue "village" with LGD code 69202, mapped to Gram Panchayat Mahajan (LGD local body 36115, block Lunkaransar 633). Gives LGD codes for the crosswalk.
found_via: LGD web service document downloadDoc.do?fileType=W; POST villageEntity, villageList, villageListWithHierarchy

title: LGD hierarchy and GP coverage: Mahajan Fieldfiring Range (69202) and key villages (Naya Khanisar, Birmana, Ajeetmana, Phuleji, Chak Jor)
what_it_contains: Raw LGD JSON for 9 villages and 6 gram panchayats. GP Mahajan (36115) covers Mahajan (69228), Mahajan-172-400 RD (954623) and Mahajan Fieldfiring Range (69202). GP Chakjohad (36099) covers Phuleji (69203), Chakjor (69204), Naya Khanisar (925986) and Phuleji chaks. Naya Khanisar is an LGD-only village (no census code) with effective date 2013-08-26.
why_relevant: New lead: a village named "Naya Khanisar" (New Khanisar) exists at the edge of the range, in the same GP as Phuleji; probably a resettlement of Khanisar families (not yet proven). Also documents the GP to which the range land belongs.

title: Census 2001 DCH Bikaner Part A&B: alphabetical village list with 2001 and 1991 location codes; village directory and PCA (already in repo as dch_bikaner_2001_partAB.txt)
what_it_contains: Alphabetical list (printed p.~126): "Mahajan Fieldfiring Range 00509900, 1991 location code 020020002000200013". The same book prints the range area as 13,177.0 ha (VD and PCA), against 136,411 ha in 1991 and 136,406 ha in 2011: probably a misprint. Also lists "Krishan Nagar 00564900" and "Ramnagar 00565500" in Panchayat Samiti Lunkaransar with NO 1991 code (new villages after 1991): Krishan Nagar 6,349 ha, 1,277 persons, 155 households; Ramnagar 7,614 ha, 1,792 persons, 205 households, with primary, middle and secondary school and a health sub-centre.
why_relevant: Gives the official 1991->2001 code link for the range (0013 -> 00509900). Flags the 13,177 ha area as an error to avoid. Identifies two post-1991 villages whose names match the resettlement villages named by the Ministry of Defence (see SC Defence 2006 record).

title: Lok Sabha Standing Committee on Defence (14th LS), 13th Report "A Critical Review of Rehabilitation of Displaced Persons", 3 Aug 2006, paras 3.65-3.69
what_it_contains: Para 3.65: project sanctioned 2 Nov 1982; total land 3,32,985 acres, of which 1,25,035.70 acres private; possession handed over 1987; land acquired from "33 villages of district Bikaner"; 3,256 families affected; Rs 89.54 lakh rehabilitation. Para 3.67: 1,08,316 acres agricultural land allotted; "Three new villages created for resettlement: Ram Nagar, Krishna Nagar, Kumbhan bass; resettled in 6 other villages"; 60x90 ft plots given 1986-87. Para 3.68: award Rs 64.11 crore; Collector estimate Rs 500/bigha vs MoD Rs 300/bigha; paid Rs 700-1,000/bigha; meeting 29.1.81 decided lump sum Rs 2,500 per displaced family; after HC order Rs 2,750. Para 3.69: Committee calls it "meagre".
why_relevant: Official MoD figures (33 villages, 3,256 families, acreage) and the NAMES of the resettlement villages, which match Census villages Ramnagar (069794) and Krishan Nagar (069788) in Chhatargarh tehsil. Not previously in the repo.
